blocks.text: Washington, United States—Oklahoma City big man Chet Holmgren will miss eight to 10 weeks with a knee tendon tear, the NBA team said Friday, the latest injury blow for the 2025 champions. The Thunder said in a statement that Holmgren experienced discomfort in his right knee on October 25. “After a series of consultations with specialists, the determination was to perform a biological treatment (Friday) to address a small patellar tendon tear,” the team said.
